label: last two copy-phase outputs (sparse, token-selective)
explanation: Fires almost only in the copy phase (95% of mass) on the last two output steps (to_go 0: 71% of mass, to_go 1: 19%). It never fires at the delimiter, at t=0/1, or on the first two copy outputs. The only original-phase activity is a weak blip at t=2, mostly when the input is t. Within that window it fires on just ~5% of steps, and which ones depends on the current input token (strongest for t and q, then f, d, 1, x) and somewhat on length (L=3, 6, 7 favored; L=5 and 9 rare), but token and length conditions did not give a clean rule (best F1 about 0.29). The strongest activations are L=3 sequences with input t/q/d/m on the final step. Mass recall is high but precision is low.
